integration_rules: Keep collection claims, examinations, traces, inferred purpose, human activity and excluded controls filterable separately.
A direct_report label describes what testimony explicitly claims, not verification of the event or a mission.
Do not infer biological categories from protective suits, a craft arm, backlit silhouettes, case fame or an associated crop trace.
Preserve report date separately from alleged event date, approximate flags and source-version conflicts.
Source-family grouping can prevent obvious copied representations being counted repeatedly, but unresolved groups must not be advertised as unique authenticated incidents.
Unmatched web dossiers may support exploratory country/year comparisons where stated; they must not receive fabricated coordinates, canonical IDs or exact timestamp joins.
